THESE_ARE_QUOTES_NOT_FILLS.what_is_measured: USDC -> token -> USDC, read-only router quotes. cost_pct = (in - back) / in, in percent of notional. POOL cost only: fee plus price impact at that clip.
not_modelled: gas (a dollar per leg, not a rate)
THESE_ARE_QUOTES_NOT_FILLS.slippage_caveat: THESE ARE QUOTES, NOT FILLS. The live lane measured 13.5-27.8 bp of round-trip slippage (pooled over 38 legs, and at the $0.75 clip respectively) that NO quote here carries, and MEV is unmodelled entirely. Every cost in this file is therefore a FLOOR -- the best case -- and is NOT a realisable cost. The two slippage figures are the same quantity at different clips, not a disagreement.
THESE_ARE_QUOTES_NOT_FILLS.fills_beat_quotes: storage/trading_cache.db trade_fills holds 38 real executed legs. Where a quote here disagrees with a fill for the same symbol, THE QUOTE IS THE SUSPECT.
THESE_ARE_QUOTES_NOT_FILLS.no_default_rate: A symbol absent from 'quoted' is charged NOTHING. There is no default, no nearest neighbour and no chain average. This repo shipped 'round_trip_cost measured its own default' on 2026-09-04; this file will not.

measured_gas_context.source: trade_outcomes.fee_cost where details.mode == 'live'; gas only on that path
measured_gas_context.warning: GAS IS NOT IN THE 'quoted' RATES. Those are pool cost (fee + impact) only. Do not add these two numbers without deciding which clip you are charging at.

instrument.quoter: Uniswap V3 QuoterV2 quoteExactInput, asked directly
instrument.plausibility_floor: cost_pct >= 2 * fee_tier / 10000; readings below it are recorded under 'implausible' and NEVER published as a rate
instrument.why_not_the_router_provider: UniswapV3Local picks the best tier per leg INDEPENDENTLY, which crosses two pools and produced negative round-trip costs (AERO -0.0464%, -0.0982%) -- the artifact pass 452 retracted. It also swallows HTTP 429 and reports it as 'no viable pool', making a throttle indistinguishable from an absent pool.
instrument.multihop_routes_not_searched: only DIRECT USDC<->token pools are priced. A token that only trades through WETH is reported UNQUOTABLE here, not cheap.

unquotable_causes.no_address_in_book: data/token_addresses.json has no address for this symbol on this chain. NOT a statement about the pool -- the census never got to ask. Fixable here, but NOT by resolving the ticker: this repo has already been bitten by ticker squatting, and a wrong address would produce a confident cost for the wrong token.
unquotable_causes.no_plausible_tier: every Uniswap V3 fee tier either had no direct USDC<->token pool or round-tripped BELOW its own 2*fee floor, which is a broken measurement rather than a cheap pool.
unquotable_causes.tier_priced_nothing: a tier was chosen at the probe clip but priced nothing anywhere on the clip grid.
unquotable_causes.endpoint_throttled: the only working Base endpoint answered 429 after every retry. A throttle is not a fact about a pool, so this is UNRESOLVED, never UNQUOTABLE.
